name: Exclude requested scope
interpretation_rule: Attach exclusion to the governed request/service/topic/channel, not to all following text.
dangerous_shortcut: Deleting negation then retrieving the excluded topic.

name: Negative proposition question
interpretation_rule: Retain the questioned predicate; truth remains unresolved until business evidence.
dangerous_shortcut: Interpreting a negative question as a request exclusion or a true policy assertion.

name: Egyptian discontinuous negation
interpretation_rule: Bind ma/sh or its spelling variants to the verb and its arguments, preserving question/scenario role.
dangerous_shortcut: Dropping suffix sh or treating every word starting ma as negated.

name: Not only but also
interpretation_rule: Add the first and subsequent scopes; NOT ONLY does not exclude the first.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating the first topic as negative/excluded.

name: Only focus
interpretation_rule: Restrict the focus to the named scope, unless bas introduces contrast or NOT ONLY.
dangerous_shortcut: Mapping every bas/just to a business exception.

name: Correction
interpretation_rule: Replace abandoned scope; preserve resolved antecedents only when compatible.
dangerous_shortcut: Appending the corrected request to the wrong original scope.

name: Neither nor
interpretation_rule: Exclude both scopes only in request-exclusion context; propositional negatives still request a rule if questioned.
dangerous_shortcut: Ignoring one negated conjunct.

name: Additive conjunction
interpretation_rule: Combine obligations with local scope; copy only clearly shared predicates/modifiers.
dangerous_shortcut: Cartesian-product all providers and all topics.

name: Shared predicate
interpretation_rule: Distribute a genuinely shared predicate across the explicit list.
dangerous_shortcut: Never sharing a predicate or sharing unrelated clause predicates.

name: Respectively

en: for the first and the second

interpretation_rule: Bind ordered service/topic/channel lists positionally only when the linguistic relation is explicit.
dangerous_shortcut: Binding by answer paragraph position or guessing list correspondence.

name: Comparison alternatives
interpretation_rule: OR in a comparison requests evidence for alternatives; do not arbitrarily drop an alternative.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating every OR as exclusion or a conjunction of mandatory requirements.

name: Instead of
interpretation_rule: Use the predicate: comparison of costs for each retains both channels; replacement request retains the new one.
dangerous_shortcut: Always deleting the old alternative when instead appears.

name: Context frame
interpretation_rule: Treat background as context unless an interrogative/request predicate explicitly targets it.
dangerous_shortcut: Promoting every service/topic noun in context to an obligation.

name: Reported assertion
interpretation_rule: Store as user claim, not policy evidence; verify if requested.
dangerous_shortcut: Using a user-supplied fee as a canonical answer.

name: Conditional antecedent
interpretation_rule: Retain antecedent as user scenario, with subject/predicate/value and scope.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating the scenario as a factual source rule.

name: Necessary condition
interpretation_rule: Keep only-if direction: action implies condition; it does not alone establish that condition guarantees action.
dangerous_shortcut: Reversing necessary and sufficient conditions.

name: Unless / exception condition
interpretation_rule: Preserve exception and trigger under its governed rule; do not remove a negative globally.
dangerous_shortcut: Converting unless to unconditional permission.

name: Without
interpretation_rule: Distinguish missing prerequisite scenario from presentation request without explanation.
dangerous_shortcut: A request without documents becoming exclusion of the documents requirement.

name: Sequence
interpretation_rule: Order steps only where a procedural or temporal relation is requested/source-supported.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating a simple list of questions as mandatory business step order.

name: Full procedural scope
interpretation_rule: Create a whole-procedure obligation in the named process scope, not a final-step lookup.
dangerous_shortcut: Returning only a branch visit while claiming a full workflow.

name: Partial procedure scope
interpretation_rule: A requested suffix/step need not repeat completed steps; scope and preconditions stay explicit.
dangerous_shortcut: Always forcing a full procedure or returning an unsupported next step.

name: Ellipsis
interpretation_rule: Inherit only compatible meaning from explicit local dialogue state; unresolved antecedents need clarification.
dangerous_shortcut: Cross-session inheritance or copying another provider facts.

name: Anaphora / reference
interpretation_rule: Resolve typed referents (image, funding, service, phone) from active context, not just closest token.
dangerous_shortcut: Interpreting a screenshot pronoun as the phone mentioned in the same sentence.

name: Uncertainty request
interpretation_rule: Acknowledge uncertainty without treating it as absence of evidence; retrieve exact requested proposition.
dangerous_shortcut: Generic refusal despite a clear answerable intent.

name: Reformulation
interpretation_rule: Merge semantic duplicates only when they truly restate the same scoped request.
dangerous_shortcut: Dropping a second distinct request merely because it shares deposit words.

name: Quantifier / exhaustive list
interpretation_rule: Complete means complete for the explicit requested scope and evidence inventory; missing inventory blocks completeness.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating all available facts as all facts that exist.

name: Topic-specific minimum
interpretation_rule: Attach minimum to its head quantity, retaining fee/amount/balance units.
dangerous_shortcut: Minimum always becoming initial funding.

name: Channel versus provider
interpretation_rule: Resolve provider and channel as different fields; generic branch/machine may require clarification.
dangerous_shortcut: The word bank or branch creating a new unrelated provider.

name: Compound label
interpretation_rule: Head determines requested property; modifiers narrow it without adding separate requests.
dangerous_shortcut: Cash-out code becoming code plus withdrawal fees plus workflow.

name: Presentation preference
interpretation_rule: Record language/style separately from business intent; never alter source facts for style.
dangerous_shortcut: English label translating/altering service names or numbers.

name: Request contradiction

en: tell me but do not tell

interpretation_rule: Ask clarification when exact same scope is included and excluded with no clear correction.
dangerous_shortcut: Choosing the interpretation with easiest available evidence.

name: Alternative versus simultaneous obligation
interpretation_rule: Preserve conjunction/disjunction; required A OR B does not mean A AND B.
dangerous_shortcut: Collapsing conjunctions into a flat bag of entities.

name: Timeframe binding
interpretation_rule: Bind period to each amount/count/condition independently.
dangerous_shortcut: Attaching every period in a compound question to every fact.

name: Contrastive correction of assumption

ar_msa: هل هذا مبلغ إيداع أم رسوم
en: a deposit rather than a fee

interpretation_rule: Interpret disputed category as a verification/difference request, not as authority to relabel money.
dangerous_shortcut: Assuming a question asserts the correct financial category.

name: Reported customer demand vs employee request
interpretation_rule: Identify the outer request and retain quoted demand as context; a quoted refund demand is not authorization.
dangerous_shortcut: Executing a quoted request instead of drafting the employee response.

name: Emotion is not a financial entitlement
interpretation_rule: Attach emotion to communication tone, not to refund eligibility, priority or verified fault.
dangerous_shortcut: Promising payment or admitting liability to de-escalate.

name: Action request vs status question
interpretation_rule: Tense, modality and agent roles distinguish a requested action from reading a past/current state.
dangerous_shortcut: Cancelling an operation because the user asked whether it was cancelled.

name: Closed versus resolved
interpretation_rule: Administrative closure and successful customer resolution are distinct attributes.
dangerous_shortcut: Using status closed as proof the issue was fixed.

name: Acknowledgment versus confirmation
interpretation_rule: Acknowledgment alone does not authorize closure, withdrawal or execution.
dangerous_shortcut: Treating thanks as consent to terminate a complaint.

name: Customer deadline versus documented SLA
interpretation_rule: Record requested timing separately from promised/authorized timing; source governs service obligations.
dangerous_shortcut: Converting urgency or wishes into a guaranteed deadline.

name: Identifier object binding
interpretation_rule: Preserve identifier object and character sequence; do not infer sensitive values or swap reference with operation code.
dangerous_shortcut: Changing codes, stripping leading zeros or using a complaint ID as a bank transaction ID.

name: Retail object type controls meaning
interpretation_rule: Disambiguate amount/count/entity using the governing noun and process.
dangerous_shortcut: Using the financial balance answer for warehouse stock.

name: Cash versus cache
interpretation_rule: Use action/object evidence: withdraw cash vs clear cache; literal sound similarity is insufficient.
dangerous_shortcut: Sending cash-handling rules for a device-cache request.

name: Cannot do is not do not want
interpretation_rule: Distinguish inability, prohibition and preference; all can contain negative wording.
dangerous_shortcut: Cancelling the complaint when the customer cannot access its status.

name: No promise while drafting
interpretation_rule: Constrain the reply style while retaining the requested business topic.
dangerous_shortcut: Deleting the refund-status topic merely because a promise is excluded.

name: Ordered verification before reply
interpretation_rule: A dependency can require unavailable live evidence; no fabricated intermediate result.
dangerous_shortcut: Claiming the complaint is resolved in a draft before verifying actual status.
